Recommending the Workflow of Vietnamese Sign Language Translation via a Comparison of Several Classification Algorithms

Luyl-Da Quach, Nghia Duong-Trung, Anh-Van Vu, Chi-Ngon Nguyen

Computational Linguistics · PACLING 2019, Communications in Computer and Information Science, vol. 1215 · pp. 134–141

PACLING 2019 proceedings chapter, published in 2020.

Publisher / DOIRead PDF

Overview

Evaluates classification methods within a Vietnamese Sign Language translation pipeline, focusing on the mapping from written Vietnamese to written sign-language sentences. The study informs model selection for preserving semantic content before visual gesture generation.
